locator: ESM 1 Table 1, p. 1, Family column, block heading above Rhinolophus ferrumequinum
evidence: ESM 1 p. 1 prints 'Rhinolophuidae' as the family label for the four Rhinolophus rows. No such family exists; the family of Rhinolophus is Rhinolophidae (Gray, 1825), spelt correctly elsewhere in the literature the ESM cites. The four species in the block (R. ferrumequinum, R. hipposideros, R. landeri, R. mehelyi) are all Rhinolophidae.
status_reason: misspelling visible on the page render of ESM 1 p. 1; the correct family is not in doubt
note: The analysis CSV keeps the printed label in family_printed, per the convention that a publication error is flagged, not corrected. Only the family label is affected; no measurement or species name is involved.
